method.unit: Complete existing grammar candidate gesture, including units longer than eight quarter notes; no new segmentation.
method.song_votes: One vote per canonical artist/song identity within each group or exact duration; occurrences are separate. Artist populations add without balancing.
method.duplicate_observations: Identical source song/revision/part, bounds and occurrence membership are merged across captures.

song_aliases.reason: Cloud Cascade and explicitly labelled Cloud Cascade (6-string adapted riff). No fuzzy title matching.

method.rank: Distinct-song support within selected artists, descending; ID breaks ties. Multi-label groups overlap and must not be added as total songs.
method.length: Prefer exact observed 4/8/16q duration with most distinct-song support; otherwise map most-supported observed duration to nearest offered length. Ties choose shorter. This is a builder recommendation, not an average natural section.
method.metrics: Observation-weighted descriptive summaries; song_balanced_mean_q gives each song equal total weight. Written empty time includes held occupancy, not acoustic silence.
method.source_focus: More than half actual attack groups determines single/interval/triad/chord; otherwise mixed. Duplicate pitch members count separately.
method.shape_scope: Existing reported Drop E shape links; open strings and unreported single-contact contexts are not shapes.

limits: Candidate gestures are not human-verified phrase or section boundaries.
Styles are inherited whole-capture annotations, not independently classified local gestures.
Existing fixed bar windows and maximum-eight-quarter-note package limits do not determine measured lengths.
Known explicit adaptation is one song vote; unrecognized title variants may remain separate identities.
Preset changes only style, focus and builder length. Traits do not become new engine controls.
Current artist/mode/template availability and bounded realization still apply; support is not a guarantee of generation or listening quality.
